engineering-managers-measuring-engineers.core: Posted in last 7 days Engineering Managers - Measuring Engineers When Using AI Two engineers deliver the same result. One writes every line by hand. The other uses AI and finishes in half the time. Who's the better engineer? 🤔 That's the question behind Edition 02 of The Practical AI Manager. My take: AI can remove effort, but it can't remove accountability. The output still belongs to the engineer. Also inside this edition: 🔓 Gemini "accidentally" logged into three real systems, because the test environment wasn't as sandboxed as it looked 📱 Siri is getting a Gemini brain ⚙️ Why coding agents are shifting the bottleneck from writing code to review and CI Swipe through the PDF 👇 And I'd like to hear from you: should engineers be measured by effort, expertise, speed or outcomes? The best replies may get featured in a future edition. #AI #Leadership #EngineeringManagement #AIEngineering #FutureOfWork The Practical AI Manager

creative-industry-professionals-podcast-.headline: Creative Industry Professionals - Podcast on AI Impact
creative-industry-professionals-podcast-.author: Stefanie Calleja-Gera ABIPP
creative-industry-professionals-podcast-.core: Posted in last 7 days Creative Industry Professionals - Podcast on AI Impact Last week I launched something I've been quietly building for months: Between the Briefs with Stefanie Calleja-Gera (the podcast)! 🎙️ After years behind the camera on commercial shoots, I've learned that the most interesting stuff often happens in between the brief and the finished result: the problem-solving, the curveballs, the last-minute saves (sometimes the horror stories!) and the lessons learned the hard way. On the podcast, we're talking about all that plus where the creative industry is heading, including how AI is changing the future of the creative landscape and what it means for the people who make it. In upcoming episodes, I'll be sitting down with creatives from right across the industry, from set builders to creative directors, to get the lowdown on where they think things are going, along with their best success stories and a few horror stories too. The first episode went live on Friday last week and the response so far has blown me away. Within 30 hours of launching, Between the Briefs reached the top 50% of streamed podcasts globally. I'm so grateful to everyone who has listened, shared, rated and supported the show. A special thank you to Oli Craddock, who joined me as co-host for episode one and brought so much energy to it, and to my brilliant producer Richard Lannen of Nozzle Media, who makes every episode look and sound fantastic. If you work in the creative industries, run a brand, or are simply curious about what really goes on behind the scenes, I'd love for you to give it a listen and while the guest list is pretty full up now for the remainder of this year, if you have an important view on the creative world, drop me a line so we can have a chat, and maybe you could be a future guest on the show! 👇 Check it out via the links below, and if you enjoy it, a follow, rating or share would mean the world: https://lnkd.in/e-ChShR4 https://lnkd.in/erVuW5q5 #BetweenTheBriefs #Podcast #PodcastLaunch #CreativeIndustries #AIinCreative #FutureOfWork #CommercialPhotography #CreativeDirection #CreativeBusiness #Branding #UKBusiness
